purpose: Prepare and inspect a small grounded-revision optimization probe; not a substantive national-persona trial

allocation.lifetime: sleep infinity until Slurm wall limit
allocation.scheduler_reason: Trillium requires one GPU or a multiple of four; explicit memory requests are disallowed

smoke.purpose: Two optimizer steps; check all-rank execution, finite loss and saved adapter

fit-probe.purpose: Deliberate repeated exposure to ten examples; diagnose optimization/format learning, not generalization

before_any_gpu_training: Verify current model bytes and installed dependencies
Complete the user's evaluation-first gate before launching training
after_each_run: Check loss/gradient norms, per-rank execution, token counts and memory
Reload adapter and run the frozen same-evidence evaluation
Inspect unsupported claims, lost qualifications, repetition and output caps before expanding
